reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, and then "no magnesium oxide" and fully chelated bisglycinate. I'd skip the complex because citrate is what gives me cramps, and I'd try one box of the bisglycinate before I put anything on Subscribe & Save.
objection: No reviews yet, and $1 a day is a lot more than the bisglycinate I can already get on Amazon. I'd be paying extra for a lab report I haven't opened and a brand I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A few dozen real verified reviews, or a batch report that opens on my phone and shows the magnesium content matches the label. A smaller trial pack at a lower price would also do it.
